firstTracer.scopeNote: Only named fixture assertions. Observed tests are not qualified candidate checks; clean restart is not interrupted-record recovery; ImportedGitSnapshot/task_revision None remain unchanged.

tickets.acceptance: One disposable Git fixture, one confirmed task, one actual provider, exact one-file contribution, actual host import/query and controlled restart.
Retain original receipts; require matching contribution/import/query commit, tree, repository/root/epoch, exact changed paths and separate actual test observation.
Inspect original task/run/contribution/test/query facts and scope limitations; link same report from existing evidence UI without inferred authorship or source acceptance.

unresolvedInterpretations.note: Unmodified upstream CLI/skills claim is not validated and conflicts with already specified adaptations. Choose and qualify exactly one real ingress or the explicit adapted-bindings fallback; no silent runtime retry or new listener by default.
ACP provenance is a target invariant, not evidence all current providers have causal coverage. Ambiguous or incomplete observations remain unknown.
Read-only derived indexing avoids source-authority recovery gates; durable publication, clean restart and idempotent reprepare remain tested separately.
The host stays off hot status/change paths. T1 explicit bounded cold code queries are not a status/read-model fallback.
